description: This file defines the IBasketService interface, which declares asynchronous methods for managing shopping basket operations in the application, such as transferring baskets, adding items, setting quantities, and deleting baskets.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers a basket from an anonymous session to an authenticated user.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to the user's basket with specified quantity and price.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Sets multiple item quantities in the basket.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes the basket with the specified ID.
